messages:
Priya N: quick sync: product wants a compact 'notify sensitivity' display on SLO cards + last override info. need API contract before we wire UI.
Caleb M: proposed server-side endpoint `GET /v1/tenants/:id/notify-status` returning a flattened object: computed_sensitivity, active_override:{actor,ttl}, last_action_reason. keeps front-end dumb.
Rina S: server-side computation avoids drift during rollout. also we should cap the explain list to 3 items so payload stays small.
Priya N: cost showback request: tiny badge with last_1h_est_cost (number+currency) and link to billing page. not per-token.
Caleb M: agree. include cost snapshot only, computed offline and attached to notify-status to control cardinality.
Rina S: security: actor should be id/handle only, no email. strip route names that could leak PII.
ops-bot: synthetic-alert: sandbox-007 SLO breach at 3345628900 (no page) :white_check_mark:
Priya N: override UX: product wants "Reduce alerts now" button that posts `POST /v1/tenants/:id/overrides` with TTL. need guardrails.
Caleb M: guardrails proposal: dev roles -> max 4h, owners -> max 72h. all overrides generate immutable audit events.
Rina S: server validation and rate limits required to prevent misuse. also audit retention policy for prod overrides.
QA Bot: QA will run canary to synthesize backpressure and verify explain chain contains fallback reason and cost badge within 5% of billing pipeline.
Priya N: rollout plan: 1) read-only notify-status in console, 2) enable overrides for sandboxes, 3) gated prod overrides behind admin role + audits.
Caleb M: I'll draft OpenAPI snippets and sample responses with small explain arrays. assigning to eng-runtime + eng-platform, label `notify-surface-showback`.
Rina S: runtime should emit compact notify-eval telemetry so we can posterity-fill examples for explain pane.
